name: Looksmaxxer drug and peptide regimen

lead: The term refers to routines in which a person combines several prescription drugs, hormones or research peptides in pursuit of a better physique or face. Influencers in looksmaxxing publicize such stacks, which is how the idea spread.

The wider context includes the Enhanced Games, a sports event first held in Las Vegas on 24 May 2026 that permits FDA-approved performance-enhancing substances under medical supervision, which has drawn objections from anti-doping and Olympic bodies.

paras: In general terms, followers describe stacking compounds from several drug classes and tracking results with photos and lab work. Specifics vary by influencer and are not documented here.

Medical bodies and anti-doping authorities describe performance-enhancing and research compounds as carrying health risks, and many are prescription-only or unapproved. Clinicians generally advise supervised use for any prescription therapy.

angle.text: Followers use multi-compound routines in the hope of faster physique change than diet and training alone. The specific effects depend on each compound.

lead: A looksmaxxer drug and peptide regimen is a multi-drug routine, usually shared by looksmaxxing influencers, that combines prescription medications, hormones and research peptides to change body composition or appearance.

Such regimens sit alongside broader public debate on enhancement. The Enhanced Games, announced in 2023 by Aron D'Souza and held in Las Vegas on 24 May 2026, allow FDA-approved substances under medical supervision, while WADA, the IOC and other bodies have criticised the event.[1] A T Nation thread discussing the Games had nearly a thousand replies by 2026.[2]

paras: Regimens combine multiple compounds rather than a single one. Their composition differs by influencer and is not standardised, and this wiki gives no dosing or sourcing.

The Enhanced Games organisers say substances must be FDA-approved and medically supervised, and athletes are not required to use them. WADA's president called the idea very dangerous, and the IOC said it was at odds with Olympic values.[1] A T Nation thread on the Games drew extensive discussion.[2]

timeline.event: First Enhanced Games held in Las Vegas on 24 May.[1]
